additional_info.subject: RE: ID0439969-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002442] BC1 isn't working CRM:02682000227
additional_info.body:
Hello Giuseppe,
Thank you for your update via teams regarding the replacement of BC1.
Following your input, checked the connections on the XD10 and proceeded to swap BC1 with BC2. After approximately 20 minutes, the error shifted from Plug 1 to Plug 2. This behavior confirmed that the issue was with the BC1 bender.
BC1 has now been replaced with a new unit. We also performed a charging session post-replacement, and everything appears to be functioning correctly.
Kindly attach the field service report at your earliest convenience. Once received, we will proceed with the case closure.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
